summary: SES S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing the convening notice and materials for an Extraordinary General Meeting to be held on June 17, 2026. The primary agenda item is the cancellation of 35,928,624 shares (23,952,416 class A and 11,976,208 class B) repurchased under a buyback programme announced November 2, 2023, as amended May 2, 2024, with a corresponding capital reduction of EUR 44,910,780. This is a capital return to shareholders via share cancellation. No advisor or board recommendation is mentioned; the filing is procedural to effect the cancellation. Watch for shareholder approval at the EGM and subsequent capital reduction effectiveness.
